messages:
Priya Singh: FYI — CrossRun just validated their adapter v0.9 against our gateway. Need to sync on compatibility gating + announcement timing.
Darren Cole: Nice. Do we have a canonical compatibility matrix or is it still a Google doc?
Priya Singh: Draft matrix is at https://drive.redwood.example/crypto-matrix (internal). Key gaps flagged by eng.
Leah Kim: Skimmed it — main fail is kv-cache handling with LlamaIndex flows (sharded indices). Repro below.
Sam - Integrations: Repro steps I used:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/gateway/run \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD' \
  -d '{"model":"llama-13b","input":"<query>","stream":true,"adapter":"crossrun-v0.9"}'
```
Sam - Integrations: The service falls back to non-streaming path and latency spikes. Looks like streaming chunk size negotiation is mismatched.
Leah Kim: Agree — their adapter negotiates a larger chunk which forces full KV hydration on our side. Quick patch: reduce chunk to 256 tokens for streaming handshake.
Darren Cole: Can we treat this as a gating item? If streaming degenerates to sync mode, we should fail the integration check.
Priya Singh: Proposal: gating criteria = (1) passes end-to-end smoke w/ LlamaIndex, (2) streaming handshake latency < 200ms extra, (3) no KV corruption on sharded indices. Greenlight cutoff 2026-05-01.
Marta (Partner PM): Marketing wants announcement week of 2026-05-11. Legal requires embargo signoff by 2026-05-03. If gating slips we push. :calendar:
Darren Cole: Also request HW smoke on H100 and A10G (partners will list H100 perf). We should capture both p50/p95 token latencies and mem footprint.
Leah Kim: I'll run H100 + A10G smoke tomorrow and post a short spreadsheet with: model, batch, p50 token latency, p95 token latency, GPU mem.
integrations-bot: Deployment job #4523 finished: unit tests passed on main branch.
Sam - Integrations: I've opened an upstream issue with CrossRun (crossrun/crossrun#87) describing the streaming chunk mismatch and a suggested PR.
Priya Singh: Marketplace checklist (short): SSO + onboarding steps, sample terraform, deploy script, pricing matrix, co-marketing blurb, tech contact. Who owns which?
Sam - Integrations: I'll provide sample terraform + onboarding runbook.
Priya Singh: Marta — marketing for co-announcement copy?
Marta (Partner PM): Yup, I'll draft the co-announcement + partner quote. Need perf numbers & 2-3 screenshots.
Darren Cole: I'll draft an eng quote and a 2-sentence perf summary once Leah posts the numbers.
Leah Kim: Perf snapshot (preliminary H100): p50 token latency 42ms @batch8, p95 88ms, GPU mem 18.5GB. Full run results: https://ci.redwood.example/artifacts/xcrossrun-smoke-1795
Priya Singh: Great — action items summary: 
- Leah Kim: full H100/A10G smoke + perf report by 2026-05-01
- Sam - Integrations: follow up PR / repro + sample terraform by 2026-04-28
- Darren Cole: engineering quote + perf blurb by 2026-05-03
- Marta (Partner PM): draft co-announcement + screenshots by 2026-05-04
- Lina Legal: review embargo & NDA by 2026-04-29
Priya Singh: Tagging legal: @Lina Legal for embargo/NDA.
Lina Legal: Noted — will review the draft embargo & partner addendum and get back by 2026-04-29.
Priya Singh: Thanks all. If gating passes early we can aim to ship a marketplace listing + joint blog the week-of 2026-05-11. :thumbsup:
